# Auto-auth method: TPM

The `tpm` method uses TLS certificates generated by a corresponding [tpm_cert](../../agent/tpm_cert) section.

## Configuration

- `tpm_cert` `(string: required)` - The name of the corresponding `tpm_cert` stanza
  from which to obtain the `role_name`, `tpm device_path`, and cert files destination.

- `reload` `(bool: optional, default: false)` - If true, causes the local x509
  key-pair to be reloaded from disk on each authentication attempt. This is useful
  in situations where client certificates are short-lived and automatically renewed.
  Enable `enable_reauth_on_new_credentials` for immediate re-authentication when Vault issues a new certificate.
  Refer to the [auto-auth configuration](/vault/docs/agent-and-proxy/autoauth#configuration) documentation.

- `reload_period` `(duration: "1m", optional)` - The interval at which auto-auth
  checks for changes to the certificate files produced by the referenced `tpm_cert`
  stanza. Defaults to `1m` and uses
  [duration format strings](/vault/docs/concepts/duration-format).
